title: Ferrovial consortium appointed preferred bidder for €2.9 billion D35 highway PPP project in the Czech Republic
summary: Sala de prensa Ferrovial | Últimas noticias
body_markdown:
Ferrovial, through its Highways division Cintra and its Polish subsidiary Budimex, is part of the consortium **selected by the Czech Ministry of Transport as the preferred bidder to deliver a section of the D35 highway in the Czech Republic under a public-private partnership (PPP) scheme** , for an approximate value of CZK 71,324 billion (€2.9 billion)\[1\] .


“We are proud to participate in one of the Czech Republic’s most important transport infrastructure projects. **The D35 is aimed to strengthen connectivity, support economic growth, and create long-term value for local communities** . This project demonstrates how public-private partnerships can deliver essential infrastructure efficiently and sustainably while supporting the country’s long-term development,” said Ignacio Madridejos, Chief Executive Officer of Ferrovial.


**The consortium formed by Cintra, Budimex, Strabag and Invesis, submittedin July the most economically and technically advantageous tender** among the qualified bidders. The project includes the design, construction, financing, operation, and maintenance of the D35 sections between Opatovec and Staré Město and between Staré Město and Mohelnice, totaling 35.4 kilometers of the new highway. The contract also includes the operation and maintenance of the adjacent 17-kilometer section between Litomyšl and Opatovec, bringing the **total network under management to c. 52 kilometers** .


The project also includes the construction of two tunnels measuring approximately 4 kilometers and 1.3 kilometers in length. The D35 is one of the Czech Republic’s most significant transportation infrastructure projects and, upon completion, **will improve connectivity between Bohemia and Moravia** while helping relieve congestion on the existing I/35 and D1 corridors.


Ferrovial, through its Highways division Cintra, has **extensive experience developing and managing public-private partnership transportation projects** across Europe, North America, and Australia. Budimex, one of Central Europe’s leading construction companies, has delivered major road, rail, and civil infrastructure projects for decades.


\[1\] Net Present Value of Availability Payments. Exchange rate CZK/€ @31/12/2025: 24,237 ( *source: European Central Bank* )
